operation.description: Request a brand-new Wire action for a website that isn't in the catalog yet. Describe the site (website_url) and what the action should do or extract (goal); Wire generates and auto-tests a scraper, then publishes it. Asynchronous (returns status "pending") and charges credits, refunded automatically if the build fails.

country.description: Optional 2-letter country code to build and test from, for example "US".

operation.description: Create a scheduled website monitor that checks a URL every intervalMinutes (min 15) and records a change when the content differs — optionally alerting a webhook or email. scope "page" (default) watches one URL; "site" crawls the site each run and tracks pages added/removed/changed; "wire" runs a Wire action each check and diffs its JSON. watchMode "full_page" (2 credits/check) compares the whole page; "specific_data" (3 credits/check) extracts only the fields in outputSchema with AI — ideal for price/stock/status tracking. aiMode (+1 credit/check) filters out trivial noise and summarizes real changes. Active-monitor caps per plan: Free 5, Pro 20, Scale 100.
operation.title: Create a Website Monitor

url.description: The URL to watch (root URL for site scope; the Wire site's URL for wire scope).
url.title: Url

scope.description: What to monitor: one page (default), a whole site, or a Wire action.
scope.title: Scope

watchMode.description: Compare the whole page (default) or only the fields in outputSchema, extracted with AI.
watchMode.title: Watch Mode

watchFormat.description: Format compared in full_page mode. Defaults to markdown.
watchFormat.title: Watch Format

outputSchema.description: JSON Schema of the fields to track. Required when watchMode is "specific_data".
outputSchema.title: Output Schema

aiMode.description: AI meaningful-change filtering: ignores trivial noise (ads, timestamps) and summarizes real changes. +1 credit per check.
aiMode.title: Ai Mode

aiGoal.description: Natural-language description of which changes count as meaningful (used with aiMode), e.g. "only when the price drops or it goes out of stock".
aiGoal.title: Ai Goal

useBrowser.description: Render checks with a stealth headless browser (needed for JS-heavy pages). Forced true when sessionId is set.
useBrowser.title: Use Browser

country.title: Country

sessionId.title: Session Id

isActive.description: Start running immediately. Defaults to true.

operation.description: Find Wire actions for a task from a natural-language intent. Wire is a catalog of pre-built automation actions across hundreds of websites (Amazon, Walmart, LinkedIn, Airbnb, Zillow, and others) — read actions extract data, write actions perform interactions. Many read actions need no authentication. Returns ranked candidate actions, each with its action_id, type (read/write), required/optional params, credit cost, and whether auth is needed. Run a returned action with Run a Wire Action.

operation.description: Run a Wire action by its action_id — either a READ action that extracts data (search listings, fetch a product's price/specs/reviews, read a profile) or a WRITE action that performs a state-changing interaction (submit a form, add to cart). The action's type, reported by Discover Wire Actions and Get a Wire Catalog, determines which kind it is. params must match that action's parameter schema; omit for actions that take none. Some actions complete synchronously and return their data inline in this same response; others return {status, job_id} — poll GET /wire/jobs/{jobId} for those. Does not execute payments or transfer funds; such actions are refused.
